ice-nova-witch.xml with every config input that only sets named conditions or multipliers (loom_calc::poe1::config::NAMED_ONLY): PoB's values equal the bare fixture's, and no input is a reason (P3-12a).

ice-nova-witch.xml with a saved placeholder for every input loom_calc::poe1::config classifies, at values PoB would show if it used them (the enemy's cold resistance 0 and level 1 among them), and two enemy damage inputs: PoB's values equal the bare fixture's, and no placeholder is a reason (P3-12b).

ice-nova-witch.xml with three custom modifier blocks: an empty one; an enabled one of five game-text modifiers (cold resistance, life, critical strike multiplier, spell damage, cast speed) with colour codes and blank lines; a disabled one with three more. The enabled lines apply as character-wide modifiers, the disabled ones not (P3-12c).

ice-nova-witch.xml with PoB's legacy customMods input twice (the last counts) and one empty disabled block: PoB moves the second input's five game-text lines (raw line breaks, colour codes, a tab, blank lines) into the block, and they apply as character-wide modifiers (P3-12d).

ice-nova-witch.xml with its config in PoB's layout before config sets (no ConfigSet element): an enemy level placeholder and a legacy customMods input of three lines, which PoB loads into set 1 and moves into its default block, so they apply (P3-12e).

ice-nova-witch.xml using power, frenzy, and endurance charges at their maximum (3 each): increased critical strike chance per power charge, increased cast speed and more damage per frenzy charge; endurance charges reach no slice field (P3-12e).

smite-templar.xml using charges with counts set: one power charge (the override's placeholder), two frenzy charges (increased attack speed, more damage), one endurance charge; fortified with 10 stacks, which reach no slice field (P3-12e).

ice-nova-witch.xml against a shocked Uber boss in 40% delirium: the enemy's damage taken (35% increased from the configured shock, 70% less for the Uber boss and 32% less from delirium, one name rounded to two decimals); Alira's +15% to all elemental resistances (P3-12f).

smite-templar.xml against a shocked enemy in 20% delirium: a configured 70% shock capped at 50% increased damage taken, 16% less; the physical hit's armour reduction computed before the damage taken; Oak's +40 to maximum Life; Onslaught's 20% increased attack speed, with the weapon's rate (P3-12f).

ice-nova-witch.xml with Onslaught (20% increased cast speed), 30 rage, and the enemy exposed to cold and fire: rage and exposure act only with a source of rage or of exposure, which the build lacks, so only Onslaught changes a field (P3-12f).
A level 90 Witch casting Ice Nova (level 20) alone: base damage from the skill's level, crit, cast speed, the default enemy's cold resistance (P3-9b).
A level 40 Witch casting Ice Nova at level 10 with 20% quality: another level's base damage; quality adds only area (P3-9b).
Ice Nova with Added Cold Damage: added damage scaled by the skill's damage effectiveness (P3-9b).
Ice Nova with Controlled Destruction: more spell damage, less critical strike chance (P3-9b).
Ice Nova with Increased Critical Strikes: additional base and increased critical strike chance (P3-9b).
Ice Nova with Cold Penetration: penetration of the default enemy's cold resistance (P3-9b).
Ice Nova with Faster Casting: increased cast speed (P3-9b).
Ice Nova with Increased Critical Damage: critical strike multiplier (P3-9b).
Ice Nova with jewellery (rare, original): added cold damage to spells; increased spell, cold, elemental and generic damage; cast speed (P3-9b).
Ice Nova with jewellery (rare, original): spell critical strike chance, global critical strike chance and multiplier (P3-9b).
Ice Nova against an enemy configured with 80% cold resistance (above the default maximum of 75%, which the input raises) and level 70 (P3-9b).

Smite (level 20, Melee Hit) with a normal Siege Axe: weapon damage, attack rate and crit, accuracy against the default enemy's evasion, 50% conversion to lightning, the aura's added lightning, the enemy's armour (P3-10).
Smite (level 20, 20% quality) Area Hit: the skill's less area damage, its quality, area and not melee (P3-10).
Smite with a rare Siege Axe (20% quality): local added physical and lightning damage, increased physical damage, attack speed, crit chance, accuracy (P3-10).
Smite with Melee Physical Damage: more physical melee damage (also on the converted part), less attack speed (P3-10).
Smite Area Hit with Melee Physical Damage: the more melee damage does not apply to the area hit (P3-10).
Smite with Elemental Damage with Attacks and Added Lightning Damage: more elemental attack damage, added lightning times effectiveness (P3-10).
Smite with jewellery (rare, original): added physical damage to attacks, accuracy and increased accuracy, increased physical, melee, attack, lightning damage, attack speed (P3-10).
Smite with an amulet (rare, original): global crit chance and multiplier on an attack (P3-10).
A level 40 Templar, Smite level 10 with a normal Double Axe (10% quality): another level, a two-handed weapon, weapon quality (P3-10).
Smite against a configured enemy: level 70, 20000 armour, 3000 evasion, 40% lightning resistance (P3-10).

A level 90 Witch with two rings, an amulet and a belt (rare, original) whose lines are ranges with PoB's roll: rolls between the ends, a tie on a reduced line, implicit rolls, and an agreeing ModRange (P3-8b).

Smite with a Karui Maul (1000 ms) and an amulet (rare, original): increased attack and cast speed, elemental damage with attack skills, melee critical strike chance; minion damage and a chance to freeze, shock and ignite, which change no slice field (P3-8c).
Ice Nova with an amulet (rare, original): increased attack and cast speed on a spell (P3-8c).

ice-nova-witch.xml with the pantheon's Arakaali and Shakari: Arakaali's chaos resistance against damage over time (PoB: a Dot-flagged ChaosResist, not the shown resistance) and damage over time taken; Shakari's chaos damage taken and poison on you; every soul applies and none changes a slice field (P3-12g).

ice-nova-witch.xml with the pantheon's Solaris and Yugul: Solaris's physical damage reduction, area and elemental damage taken; Yugul's reflected damage, reflected hexes, and curse effect on you (no curse on you); every soul applies and none changes a slice field (P3-12g).

ice-nova-witch.xml with the pantheon's Lunaris and Garukhan: Lunaris's per-enemy damage reduction and movement speed, projectile avoidance; Garukhan's shock on you, Blind immunity (not blinded), Maim avoidance; every soul applies and none changes a slice field (P3-12g).

ice-nova-witch.xml with the pantheon's TheBrineKing and Gruthkul: the Brine King's stun, freeze, and chill on you; Gruthkul's damage reduction per hit taken and the enemy's attack speed; every soul applies and none changes a slice field (P3-12g).

ice-nova-witch.xml against an unnerved, intimidated, blinded enemy: Unnerve's 10% increased spell damage taken; Intimidate (attacks) and Blind (evasion) change nothing on a spell; ten inputs that only set names modifiers read (P3-12g).

smite-templar.xml against an intimidated, blinded, unnerved enemy: Intimidate's 10% increased attack damage taken, Blind's 20% less evasion in the chance to hit; Unnerve (spells) changes nothing on an attack; ten inputs that only set names modifiers read (P3-12g).

smite-templar.xml on a Karui Maul with the other gems of an act 1 Smite setup: inert skills and supports (Ground Slam with Chance to Bleed and Ruthless, Frostblink, Leap Slam with Faster Attacks, Holy Flame Totem with Summon Phantasm), Precision and Clarity at level 2 (accuracy, increased critical strike chance, flat mana reservation), and a level 1 Precision whose buff the level 2 one outvalues (P3-12h).

smite-templar.xml on a Karui Maul with Blood Rage (increased attack speed), Haste (increased attack speed, 50% of mana reserved), Arctic Armour (its reservation; its effects reach no slice field), and a Haste with enableGlobal1 off that PoB does not create (P3-12h).
ice-nova-witch.xml with Zealotry (more spell damage, increased spell critical strike chance) and Discipline (energy shield), each reserving a percentage of mana (P3-12h).

ice-nova-witch.xml with Herald of Ice twice: level 20 linked to Increased Critical Strikes (a cost multiplier on a percent reservation) and level 5 alone; the buff keeps the larger added cold damage, both reserve (P3-12h).

ice-nova-witch.xml with its gems in a Plate Vest socketed B-B-R-W G-B: Ice Nova and Controlled Destruction in blue sockets (+10 quality each), Increased Critical Strikes in a red socket and Faster Casting in a white one (none); a second group in the same slot from socket 5, Precision in green (+10), Haste in blue (none) (P3-12i).
A Karui Maul socketed R-R-G holding Smite, Melee Physical Damage, and Faster Attacks, each in a socket of its colour (+10 quality each) (P3-12i).
ice-nova-witch.xml with the custom modifier 'Onslaught' alone, the check off: Onslaught's 20% increased cast speed (P3-12j).
ice-nova-witch.xml with the custom modifier 'Onslaught' in two blocks and the buffOnslaught check: Onslaught once (P3-12j).
ice-nova-witch.xml with power charges used and charge modifiers as custom lines: +1 maximum (4 charges), increased damage, spell damage, crit chance, and crit multiplier per power charge (P3-8d).
ice-nova-witch.xml without the power charge check, with +2 minimum power charges and spell damage per power charge: two charges (P3-8d).

ice-nova-witch.xml with custom lines: 20% increased area damage, +30% critical strike multiplier for spell damage, and four stats that reach no slice field (area of effect, spell and aura area of effect, light radius) (P3-8e).
ice-nova-witch.xml with a Gnarled Branch (a staff) and custom lines while wielding a staff: spell damage, crit chance and multiplier, spell block, defences (P3-8f).
ice-nova-witch.xml with a Carved Wand and a Twig Spirit Shield and custom lines: spell damage and spell block while holding a shield; staff lines without a staff (P3-8f).
